hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; [ "$(git -C "${f%/*}" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)" = "$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)" ] || exit 0; bin=$(git -C "${f%/*}" rev-parse --show-toplevel)/node_modules/.bin || exit 0; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) "$bin/oxlint" --fix "$f" >/dev/null; "$bin/biome" check --write "$f";; *.json|*.jsonc|*.css) "$bin/biome" check --write "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */AGENTS.md|*/CLAUDE.md|*/CLAUDE.local.md|*/SKILL.md|*/.claude/rules/*.md) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; root=$(git -C "${f%/*}" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ "$(git -C "$root" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)" = "$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)" ] || exit 0; [ -f "$root/tests/agents.ts" ] && command -v bun >/dev/null || exit 0; bun "$root/tests/agents.ts" >&2 || exit 2; }

root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; gate="$root/.claude/hooks/pre-push"; [ -x "$gate" ] || gate="$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)")/.claude/hooks/pre-push"; [ -x "$gate" ] || exit 0; out=$(cd "$root" && "$gate" 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -n 150 >&2; exit 2; }
